insurer: Cholamandalam MS General Insurance Company Limited

room_rent.note: Room rent capped at ₹2,000/day for SI of ₹50,000, ₹1L and ₹2L. No room rent limit for SI above ₹2 Lakhs.

icu.note: Policy covers ICU charges as part of in-patient hospitalisation but no separate ICU sub-limit or cap is stated.

copayment.note: 20% co-payment applies only when insured is covered under Tier-2 location premium but seeks treatment in a Tier-1 location hospital. Not applicable on Daily Care Benefit, Compassionate Travel, Repatriation of Mortal Remains, and Medical Second Opinion.

sub_limits.display: Room rent capped for low SI; ambulance capped
sub_limits.note: Room rent ₹2,000/day for SI ≤₹2L; ambulance up to 1% of SI max ₹2,000/hospitalisation; recharge benefit has defined limits per SI slab; no disease-wise sub-limits otherwise.

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses; not applicable for accidents.

ped_waiting.note: Pre-existing disease waiting period is 36 months from inception. No optional reduction add-on mentioned.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Specified diseases/procedures (cataract, hernia, BPH, varicose veins, stones, joint replacement, etc.) excluded for first 24 months. Not applicable for accidents.

maternity.note: Maternity is explicitly excluded under General Exclusions (Code-Excl18). Ectopic pregnancy is covered.

cumulative_bonus.note: 10% increase per claim-free year; maximum cumulative bonus capped at 50% of SI. Reduced by 10% on a claim year.

restoration.note: 100% SI restoration once per policy year for unrelated illnesses/injuries when SI and cumulative bonus are exhausted. Separate recharge benefit for related claims (limited amounts). Restoration not available for RTA claims or for basic covers other than in-patient hospitalisation.

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered for 30 days prior to hospitalisation.

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses covered for 60 days after discharge.

day_care.note: Extensive list of 539+ day-care procedures covered as per Annexure 1. Policy states list is illustrative and not exhaustive.

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation covered but excludes specific conditions: asthma, bronchitis, arthritis, diabetes, hypertension, epilepsy, nephritis, diarrhoea, pyrexia of unknown origin, etc. Cashless not available.

ayush.note: AYUSH (Ayurveda, Yoga, Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha, Homeopathy) hospitalisation and day-care covered up to sum insured in recognised AYUSH hospitals/day-care centres.

organ_donor.note: Organ donor's hospitalisation expenses for harvesting covered. Donor's pre/post-hospitalisation and other treatment not covered.

ambulance.note: Emergency road ambulance covered up to 1% of SI subject to maximum ₹2,000 per hospitalisation.

modern_treatments.note: Policy does not explicitly mention modern/robotic treatments as a named benefit or exclusion. Day-care list includes some advanced procedures (stereotactic radiosurgery, robotic-assisted procedures implied). No specific modern treatment clause found.

consumables.display: Not covered (base); covered under Home Care add-on
consumables.note: Non-medical consumables (gloves, diapers, etc.) are explicitly excluded under Annexure 2 in the base policy. The Home Care Treatment add-on covers a defined list of consumables for home care treatment.

global_cover.note: Territorial limits restrict coverage to India only. No international/overseas treatment cover available.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of coverage (including portability/migration), no claim can be contested except on grounds of established fraud.

grace_period.note: Grace period is 15 days for monthly premium mode and 30 days for quarterly, half-yearly and annual modes.

free_look.note: 30-day free-look period from date of receipt of policy document for new policies. Not applicable on renewals or porting/migration.

portability.note: Portability to other insurers allowed as per IRDAI norms with continuity of waiting period credits.

notable_exclusions.display: Maternity, STDs, impotence treatment, circumcision (non-medical), hearing aids/eyeglasses, external congenital anomalies, non-medical consumables

optional_riders.display: Medical Second Opinion (WLMC), Flexi OP Care (OPD consultations/diagnostics), Home Care Treatment add-on
